_comment: Stryker mutation testing — flips operators / removes branches in src and reruns the suite to see which mutants the tests CATCH. A surviving mutant = a test that covers the line but asserts nothing that would notice the change (the 'shitty test' signal coverage can't detect). RUNNABLE (PD-114): the code, vitest.config.ts, the root aggregating tsconfig.json, and every mutate target below all exist. Run on demand via `pnpm test:mutation`; calibrate the gate config's break threshold from a measured run. See docs/architecture/core/Spine-Testing.md › Mutation testing + core/Core-Laws-and-Precedents.md.
_plugins_comment: Explicit plugin paths — pnpm's strict node_modules layout breaks Stryker's auto-discovery ('Cannot find Checker plugin typescript' even though it's installed).
_mutate_comment: Default scope = the high-stakes pure modules (all exist; PD-114 dropped the phantom domain/chat/routing.ts — prompt assembly is assembly/assemble.ts). Broaden on the CLI, e.g. `pnpm test:mutation --mutate 'packages/server/src/domain/chat/**/*.ts'`.
_ignore_comment: ignorePatterns prune the sandbox copy — Stryker COPIES the project tree into .stryker-tmp, so without this it tries to copy node_modules (huge), .stryker-tmp (recursive!), AND the in-repo model/venv caches: .cache/ holds the 8.8G vLLM venv (whose lib64 symlink crashes copyfile with EISDIR) and .models/ holds 25G of HF weights. Keep packages/ + tests/ + the configs.
_coverage_comment: coverageAnalysis is deliberately NOT set — the @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner IGNORES it and always uses perTest (verified in its docs + the installed runner). Each mutant runs only its covering tests; the libSQL native binding survives the runner's forced pool:'threads'.
_concurrency_comment: Box = 24 logical cores / 125GB. Stryker's own default is n-1 (=23); the old pinned 4 used a sixth of the box. 16 → ~8 checker + ~8 runner processes, leaving headroom for the OS + GPU engines / dev work. Bump toward 20 for a dedicated run.
_dashboard_comment: Dashboard reporter (mutation-score badge) is opt-in: add 'dashboard' to reporters + STRYKER_DASHBOARD_API_KEY when there's a public repo.
